description: Create shared UI components in src/components/ui/ - reusable Lit elements (cd-toggle, cd-slider, cd-select, cd-keybind-input, cd-setting-row) that replace the 5+ different toggle/slider/select implementations across views.
steps: Create src/components/ui/cd-toggle.js - LitElement. Properties: checked (Boolean), label (String), description (String), disabled (Boolean). Renders a styled toggle switch with label. Fires 'change' event with detail: { checked }. Uses CSS custom properties from the design system (--bg-elevated, --accent, --border, --text-primary, --radius-sm, --transition). Import Lit from '../../assets/lit-core-2.7.4.min.js'. Register as customElements.define('cd-toggle', CdToggle).

Create src/components/ui/cd-slider.js - LitElement. Properties: value (Number), min (Number), max (Number), step (Number), label (String), showValue (Boolean), unit (String), disabled (Boolean). Renders styled range input with label and optional value display. Fires 'input' event with detail: { value }. Style the thumb/track using --text-primary, --border, --bg-elevated. Register as 'cd-slider'.

Create src/components/ui/cd-select.js - LitElement. Properties: value (String), options (Array of {value, label}), label (String), disabled (Boolean). Renders a styled <select> wrapper. Fires 'change' event with detail: { value }. Register as 'cd-select'.

Create src/components/ui/cd-keybind-input.js - LitElement. Properties: value (String), label (String), placeholder (String). On focus, captures the next key combination (Ctrl+Shift+X format). Fires 'change' event with detail: { value: keybindString }. Handles modifier keys, arrow keys, special keys. Uses the same keybind capture logic from CustomizeView.js handleKeybindInput(). Register as 'cd-keybind-input'.

Create src/components/ui/cd-setting-row.js - LitElement. Properties: label (String), description (String). Renders a consistent row layout with label on left, description below, and a <slot> for the control on right. Uses --text-primary, --text-secondary, --border, --space-sm/md. Register as 'cd-setting-row'.
Create src/components/ui/index.js - ES module that imports all component files to ensure they are registered: import './cd-toggle.js'; import './cd-slider.js'; etc.
acceptance_criteria: cd-toggle renders a toggle switch and fires 'change' events
cd-slider renders a range slider with value display and fires 'input' events
cd-select renders a dropdown and fires 'change' events
cd-keybind-input captures key combinations and fires 'change' events
cd-setting-row provides a labeled layout with slot for controls
All components use CSS custom properties from the existing design system in index.html
All components are self-registering (customElements.define in their own file)
verification: Verify all component files are valid ES module syntax (no CommonJS)
Verify all imports reference the relative path to lit-core-2.7.4.min.js
Verify each component file calls customElements.define()
Verify no external package imports (no @lit, no npm modules)
